Class MyShape

java.lang.Object
shapes.MyShape
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable, Cloneable
Direct Known Subclasses:
Line, Oval, Rect, ShapeGroup
public abstract class MyShape extends Object implements Serializable, Cloneable
MyShape is an abstract base class representing a 2D shape defined by two points. It provides common functionality for geometric shapes, such as bounding box calculation, center point computation, color, fill properties, movement, distance calculation, cloning, and custom serialization.

Subclasses must implement the draw(GraphicsContext) method to define how the shape is rendered on a JavaFX GraphicsContext.

Implements Serializable for object persistence and Cloneable for deep copying.
